title: NeMo Eval Author capability judgments
description: Structured skill-authored judgments for non-tool capability evidence in one trace.

schema.description: Version marker for capability judgment sidecars.

trace_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact ATIF trajectory bytes inspected for these judgments.

judged_by.description: Human-readable identifier for the skill, model, or reviewer that authored these judgments.

instructions.description: Optional note about the judging rubric or prompt used to produce these judgments.

judgments.description: Judgments keyed back to capability evidence requirements by capability name and evidence index.

nonEmptyString.description: String value that must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

itemName.description: Stable machine-readable audit item or tool name.

capability.description: Capability item name containing the judged evidence requirement.

evidence_index.description: Zero-based index into the capability's evidence_required list.

kind.description: Non-tool evidence kind being judged. tool_call evidence is intentionally excluded.

description.description: Exact description from the audit evidence requirement, used to reject stale judgments.

status.description: Whether the trace satisfies this non-tool evidence requirement.

rationale.description: Brief explanation grounded in the inspected trace.

supporting_trace_refs.description: Optional trace locations, message ids, or step references that support the judgment.
